complexity_contract.algebraic_radical_code_cost: 1 + sum bit_length of all signed integer coefficients and positive radicands in the declared exact expression tree
complexity_contract.comparison_rule: record the full complexity vector; Pareto comparisons use error metrics versus description_units and never erase dominated historical versions
complexity_contract.description_units_v1: max_K + independent_packet_rule_count + operator_library_size + syntax_tree_node_count + coefficient_code_cost + parser_context_state_count
complexity_contract.rational_coefficient_code_cost: 1 + bit_length(abs(numerator)) + bit_length(denominator) for reduced p/q; zero numerator has bit_length 0
